applies_to: OpenStax Chemistry and Chemistry: Atoms First (first editions, CC BY 4.0)

signature_features: short plain arrows (about 2.5 bond lengths) with open V heads, not filled (crops 03, 09)
species never numbered (crops 03, 09); crop 03 gives no species names and crop 09 names only the groups and the process, in plain sans-serif words
atoms or groups that change drawn in dark red #901800 (crop 09); new bond in the product drawn in the same red
functional groups framed by dashed lime-green #7CE400 outline boxes with plain side labels (crop 09)
a curved arrow leaving the main arrow to show the lost by-product (H2O in red) (crop 09)

notes.compound_label_face: no compound numbers in any crop; crop 03 has no species names and crop 09 names groups and the process, so no species-naming convention is established
notes.aromatic_rings: no aromatic ring in the reaction crops; pyridine elsewhere in the book is drawn Kekule with explicit C and H
notes.new_bond_color: null: the new peptide bond is dark red in crop 09 only; crop 03 has no coloured bonds, so the top-level value has one crop (the red is recorded under reaction_scheme)
notes.measured: bond_length_over_cap_height 3.2 is the value of crops 07 (38.4 px / 12 px) and 09 (51.2 px / 16 px); crop 04 gives 3.67 on its recorded 55 px / 15 px, so the spread is 3.2 to 3.67. line_width_over_bond_length 0.049 is the value of crops 07 (1.9 px / 38.4 px) and 09 (2.5 px / 51.2 px); crop 04 gives 0.036 (2 px / 55 px), not re-measured. bold_width_over_bond_length 0.24 is crop 04 only (13 px / 55 px). arrow_length_over_bond_length 2.5 is crop 09 only (138 px / 55 px on the recorded values; 126 px / 51.2 px on pixels, 2.46). Pixel measures use an 8-bit luminance threshold of 140 on the crop.

evidence.citation: Flowers, Theopold, Langley, Robinson et al., OpenStax Chemistry 2015, section 12.7 Catalysis
evidence.observations: reaction-coordinate diagram with smooth curves: uncatalyzed path red #BC4428, catalyzed path light blue #8894C8; Ea shown as vertical double arrows, the catalysed one red and the uncatalysed one black; Transition state and Activation energy as plain text labels; Energy and Extent of Reaction bold axis titles; condensed formulas H2C=CH2 with H2 written beneath it at the start and H3C-CH3 at the end

evidence.citation: Flowers, Theopold, Langley, Robinson et al., OpenStax Chemistry 2015, section 12.7 Catalysis
evidence.observations: smooth energy curves, uncatalyzed red #BC2404, catalyzed blue #4060F4 with two humps; labels Uncatalyzed pathway and Catalyzed pathway in plain Arial with thin leader lines, Reactants and Products in plain Arial without leader lines; axes with arrowheads, no numbers and no units

evidence.citation: Flowers, Theopold, Langley, Robinson et al., OpenStax Chemistry 2015, section 12.6 Reaction Mechanisms
evidence.observations: mechanism drawn with space-filling ball models (O red, N blue, C dark grey, element letters in white); plain arrows and plus signs inline; Transition state as small plain text under the activated complex

evidence.citation: Flowers, Theopold, Langley, Robinson et al., OpenStax Chemistry 2015, section 19.2 Coordination Chemistry of Transition Metals
evidence.observations: octahedral cis and trans [Co(H2O)4Cl2]+ with plain lines on the vertical axis, hashed wedges behind and bold wedges in front; complex in square brackets with charge + top right; title above with cis/trans in italic

evidence.citation: Flowers, Theopold, Langley, Robinson et al., OpenStax Chemistry 2015, section 19.2 Coordination Chemistry of Transition Metals
evidence.observations: the two enantiomers of [M(en)3] drawn as mirror images either side of a vertical dashed mirror line; en chelates written as condensed CH2 and NH2 labels; wedges and hashes on the octahedron

evidence.citation: Flowers, Theopold, Langley, Robinson et al., OpenStax Chemistry 2015, section 19.2 Coordination Chemistry of Transition Metals
evidence.observations: EDTA-metal complex: metal M and the six metal-donor bonds in red-brown #983820 (plain lines axial, red bold and hashed wedges equatorial); ligand in black condensed CH2 labels; charges on O as plain superscript minus

evidence.citation: Flowers, Theopold, Langley, Robinson et al., OpenStax Chemistry 2015, section 20.1 Hydrocarbons
evidence.observations: the same alkane as expanded formula (all C and H with 90 degree bonds), condensed formula and skeletal structure side by side, each named underneath in plain Arial

evidence.citation: Flowers, Theopold, Langley, Robinson et al., OpenStax Chemistry 2015, section 20.1 Hydrocarbons
evidence.observations: three butene isomers in columns: structural formula on top (the CH3 groups that differ in red-brown #983820), ball-and-stick model below, space-filling model at the bottom; cis and trans in italic, a brace grouping the two 2-butenes

evidence.citation: Flowers, Theopold, Langley, Robinson et al., OpenStax Chemistry 2015, section 20.4 Amines and Amides
evidence.observations: two amino acids joined by + over a vertical plain arrow; Condensation reaction written beside the arrow; curved arrow carrying H2O away in red #901800; reacting OH and H in red; dashed lime-green #7CE400 boxes around amino and carboxyl groups; peptide bond in red with an arrow and plain label

signature_features: dashed lime-green #7CE400 outline boxes around functional groups, labels outside the box (crop 09)
reacting atoms (OH, H), lost H2O and the new peptide bond in dark red #901800 (crop 09)
process name (Condensation reaction) beside a vertical arrow (crop 09)
reaction_scheme.notes: rests on crop 09 alone and is unambiguous there: the changed atoms, the new bond and the lost H2O are all #901800; crop 03 is a mechanism with CPK ball models and is listed under mechanism

signature_features: smooth curves on unnumbered axes with arrowheads; axis titles Energy and Extent of reaction in bold Arial
uncatalyzed path red (#BC4428 in crop 01, #BC2404 in crop 02), catalyzed path blue (#8894C8 in crop 01, #4060F4 in crop 02)
Ea as vertical double-headed arrows (crop 01 only): the catalysed arrow is red and the uncatalysed arrow black

Reactants, Products and Transition state as plain text with no leader line; thin leader lines only on the Activation energy labels (crop 01) and on the Uncatalyzed pathway and Catalyzed pathway labels (crop 02)
a thin reference line at the reactant energy and a double-headed ΔH arrow labelled ΔH < 0 exothermic (crop 01 only)
the catalysed curve has darker blue (#4D68AF) flat ends at the reactant and product levels (crop 01 only)
energy_profile.notes: no units or energy values on either crop; the red/blue pairing agrees but the exact shades differ between figures; Ea arrows and the Transition state label are in crop 01 only; top-level substrate_layout and show_plus_sign describe reaction schemes and are not applied here, since crop 01 stacks its reactant formulas (H2C=CH2 over H2) with no plus sign

signature_features: elementary steps drawn with space-filling ball models in CPK colours (O red, N blue, C dark grey) with white element letters
activated complex labelled Transition state in small plain text, no brackets or double dagger
mechanism.notes: rests on one crop; the CC BY Chemistry book has no curved-arrow mechanism figures (arrow pushing is in OpenStax Organic Chemistry, which is CC BY-NC-SA and was not used)

signature_features: octahedra drawn with plain axial lines, bold wedges to the front and hashed wedges to the back
complex ion in square brackets with the charge as a plain superscript at the top right (crop 04); the neutral EDTA chelate in crop 06 has no brackets
in the EDTA figure the metal and its six donor bonds are red-brown #983820, ligand black
coordination_complex.notes: metal_color null: black in crop 04, red-brown in crop 06; the square-bracket rule is from crop 04 only

signature_features: flat wedge-and-hash projections of octahedra with no perspective (crops 04, 05)
enantiomers drawn as mirror images separated by a vertical dashed mirror line (crop 05)
cis/trans isomers side by side with cis and trans in italic (crops 04, 08)
line formula stacked over ball-and-stick and space-filling models of the same molecule (crop 08)
the groups whose arrangement differs coloured red-brown #983820 (crop 08)
stereo_model.notes: model_style null: crops 04 and 05 are flat projections with plain lines, bold and hashed wedges, which no listed style covers; only crop 08 shows ball-and-stick and space-filling models, so perspective_3d would rest on one crop against two. No chair or Newman projections in the CC BY editions' figures checked (chapters 12, 19, 20); variation_color from crop 08 only

signature_features: one molecule shown in several notations side by side (expanded, condensed, skeletal), each captioned underneath in plain Arial (crop 07)
expanded formulas with every C and H written and bonds at 90 degrees (crop 07)
structure_panel.notes: rests on crop 07 alone. variation_color null: all black in crop 07. Crop 08 shows three different butenes (1-butene, cis- and trans-2-butene), so it is listed under stereo_model and not here
